overview: The Medford Historic District Commission approved a deck certificate of appropriateness, welcomed a new member, debated proposed historic districts on Forest Street and Cotting Street, and approved hiring a consultant to guide future district strategy.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Certificate of Appropriateness for Deck Application
items.summary: The commission unanimously approved an application for a low-profile deck behind a renovated barn.

items.title: Introduction of New Commission Member
items.summary: New commission member Chris Donovan introduced himself and discussed his background in local history and architecture.

items.title: Forest Street Historic District Proposal
items.summary: The commission reviewed a proposed reduction of the Forest Street Historic District boundary and deferred further action until the next meeting.

items.title: Proposed Single-House Historic District at 78 Cotting Street
items.summary: The commission heard testimony from property owners opposing a single-house historic district and neighbors supporting it, agreeing to consult with the Historical Commission before making a determination.

items.title: Consultant Engagement for Local Historic District Strategy
items.summary: The commission voted to hire consultant Chris Skelly for $3,000 to assist in developing a strategy for establishing local historic districts.

items.title: South Street Historic District Discussion
items.summary: Discussion regarding a potential South Street historic district was postponed to the next meeting.
